attributes.description: Comma-separated fields, optionally `field:Label`.

attributes.description: Header buttons sort on the server through the `sort` query parameter.

attributes.description: A checkbox per row and a select-all box; slot="bulk" children act on the ticked rows.

attributes.name: filters
attributes.description: Comma-separated fields that get a search box above the table; typing sets the query parameter of the same name.

attributes.description: Rows per page: sets `limit`, Previous/Next change `offset`. The response needs a `total`.

entries.name: xo-dialog
entries.summary: A modal on the native <dialog>.
entries.description: A modal on the native <dialog>. Open it with xo-open, close it with xo-close or by submitting a form inside. With `heading` it is a titled modal: a header with the title and a Close button, the content as the body, and the elements marked `slot="footer"` as the footer.

attributes.name: heading
attributes.description: The title: makes it a titled modal (header, body, footer).

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: `sm`, `wide` or `full` (the default is 40rem).

attributes.name: dismiss
attributes.description: Close it on a click outside the dialog.

example.code:
<button xo-open="#add">Add person</button>
<xo-dialog id="add" heading="Add person" size="wide" dismiss>
  <xo-form op="createPerson" submit="Add"></xo-form>
  <button slot="footer" xo-close>Cancel</button>
</xo-dialog>

entries.keywords: modal popup window overlay confirm sheet

entries.name: xo-toast
entries.summary: Shows the message of the latest xo-error event on the page (not when the event was prevented with `preventDefault()`, or its `handled` is true because a view shows `$error` itself); hides on the next xo-done or after `timeout` seconds.
entries.description: Shows the message of the latest xo-error event on the page (not when the event was prevented with `preventDefault()`, or its `handled` is true because a view shows `$error` itself); hides on the next xo-done or after `timeout` seconds. Set `detail.action` (`{ label, run }`, for example Retry) and `detail.timeout` on the error and the toast shows that button, the same way an `xo-notice` does.

attributes.name: timeout
attributes.description: Seconds before it hides (default 6, 0 = until the next success).

const clean = sanitizeHtml(untrusted, { images: false });

groups.label: Template syntax
groups.summary: What goes between braces inside an <xo-view>: paths, formats and view variables.

entries.name: {path}
entries.summary: Text or attribute interpolation.
entries.description: A path reads a field of the current item (`.` is the item itself, `a.b` is nested, `a[0].b` indexes) and then the view's `p-*` parameters. The text is escaped. A `javascript:` URL becomes `about:blank`, and `on*` attributes and `srcdoc` are not interpolated. `{{name}}` and `\{name}` stay as written, and braces around anything that is not a path (JSON, CSS) are left alone.
entries.keywords: interpolate binding mustache braces value field expression

entries.name: {path | format}
entries.summary: Show a value in a display format.
entries.description: The formats are `date`, `datetime`, `time`, `relative`, `number`, `json` and `localized`. They use `Intl` and the page language. A value that cannot be formatted is shown as it is. Add your own with `setFormat()`. An unknown name is reported once on the console and the plain value is shown.
table: A calendar date in the page language: `Nov 25, 2026`.
A number with the language's separators.
A value that is an object by language (`{ en, vi }`): the active language, then its base language, then English, then any filled one.
entries.keywords: format date time number relative json localized currency pipe filter

entries.name: $loading, $refreshing
entries.summary: Whether the view is fetching.
entries.description: `$loading` is true while a request runs and there is nothing to show yet. `$refreshing` is true while a request runs and the previous result is still on screen (a sort or a page loads), so the view does not collapse. The view also carries `data-refreshing` for CSS.

entries.name: $error
entries.summary: The error of the failed load.
entries.description: A `XoongError` with `status`, `code` and `detail`, or nothing when the load worked.
entries.keywords: failure problem message detail code status

entries.name: $index, $n
entries.summary: The position of the row in `xo-each`.
entries.description: `$index` counts from 0 and `$n` from 1. In nested `xo-each` loops `$i0` (the outer one), `$i1`, ... name the position at each depth.

entries.name: $hasPrev, $hasNext, $from, $to
entries.summary: Paging state of a list.
entries.description: For lists that take `limit` and `offset` and answer with `total`. `$from` and `$to` are the numbers of the first and the last row shown (the "1–12 of 48" text).

example.code: {$from}–{$to}

entries.keywords: pagination page offset limit total next previous

entries.name: $selectedCount, $selected
entries.summary: The ticked rows.
entries.description: `$selectedCount` is the number of ticked rows (`xo-select`), `$selected` the rows themselves, for `xo-body="$selected"`.

entries.name: $stream, $streaming
entries.summary: The events of a streamed call.
entries.description: `$stream` holds the events of the latest streamed call (an operation that answers with server-sent events) and `$streaming` whether it still runs.

entries.name: $form
entries.summary: The state of the form around you.
entries.description: Inside a `<form xo-submit>`: `$form.dirty`, `$form.valid`, `$form.submitting`, `$form.stale`, and by field path `$form.errors['title.vi']`, `$form.touched[...]`, `$form.filled[...]`.

example.code: Unsaved changes

entries.keywords: dirty valid submitting errors touched filled unsaved

entries.name: p-<name>
entries.summary: A parameter of the view's operation.
entries.description: On `<xo-view>`: `p-id="42"` is the path parameter `id`. `p-id="?id"` reads `?id=` from the page URL and `p-id=":id"` reads a route parameter. Inside the view `{id}` reads it.
entries.keywords: parameter path id route url query

entries.name: hidden="{flag}"
entries.summary: A boolean attribute that follows the data.
entries.description: When `{flag}` is the whole value of `hidden`, `disabled`, `checked`, `selected`, `readonly`, `required`, `open`, `multiple`, `inert`, `autofocus`, `controls`, `loop`, `muted` or `reversed`, the attribute is present while the value is true (an empty list is false).
entries.keywords: disabled checked selected readonly required attribute toggle
